clue.text: Fishy sanctuary for a lot of Americans?

definitions.note: Americans call a car park a parking lot, so this is a lot in American usage

parts.note: the carp is a freshwater fish, the first of the puzzle's 'fishy' pieces
an ark is a place of refuge, like Noah's

explanation.surface: A refuge for fish that many Americans might enjoy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot' reads as 'many', but it is the noun: what Americans call a parking lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A parking lot is the American name for an area where vehicles are left, the British car park.

clue.text: Reaction, by the sound of it, when apartment evacuated and I go away!

definitions.text: Reaction, by the sound of it

indicators.note: evacuated means emptied, leaving only the first and last letters of the word apartment

parts.note: shoo is what you say to tell someone to go away

explanation.surface: Someone sneezes on leaving an emptied flat and telling themselves to go.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the word written to represent a sneeze, the body's sound response to an irritant.

clue.text: Tart up, on prodding feather once?

indicators.note: prodding means the word for on is pushed into the old writing feather

parts.note: pens were once made from feathers, quills
re means on, concerning

explanation.surface: A bird tidying itself, poked by a quill.
explanation.definitionFit: To preen is to groom and smarten oneself, much as to tart up means to dress up showily.

clue.text: Second river crossed in heading on — point of no return?

indicators.note: crossed out means the second river letter is struck from the heading

parts.note: a rubric is a heading, originally written in red
R is the abbreviation for river; second says which of the two Rs goes
taken as written

explanation.surface: A second river crossed while heading on to a point of no return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crossed' suggests crossing the Rubicon itself, but it means crossing out a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Caesar's crossing of this river committed him to civil war, so the name stands for an irrevocable step.

clue.text: See 17
First of orders signed — sounded like Napoleon?

indicators.note: First of means take the opening letter of the word orders

parts.note: to ink a deal is to sign it

explanation.surface: Napoleon signing his first orders.
explanation.walkthrough: Napoleon is the pig in Orwell's Animal Farm, not the emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: Pigs grunt with an oink, so a pig named Napoleon would have made that noise.

clue.text: Dump in African capital with English religious job

indicators.note: in places the dump inside the capital city

parts.note: Rabat is the capital of Morocco
to bin something is to dump it

explanation.surface: A rubbish dump in an African capital and an English religious post.
explanation.definitionFit: The rabbinate is the office of a rabbi, a Jewish religious position.

clue.text: Material originally sewn into each frill, one of two pads

indicators.note: sewn into means the first letter is stitched inside the word for frill

parts.note: a ruff is a frilled collar

indicators.note: originally means only the first letter of the word Material is used

explanation.surface: Material stitched into a frill to make one of a pair of pads.
explanation.definitionFit: Earmuffs come as a pair of padded covers worn over the ears for warmth.

clue.text: Dramatic Irishman secreting fishy weapon?

indicators.note: secreting means hiding, so the name holds the fishy weapon inside it

parts.note: Sean is a typical Irish man's name
the hake is a sea fish
a spear is a weapon

explanation.surface: An Irishman hiding a suspicious weapon in dramatic fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespearean means relating to Shakespeare's plays, and also grandly theatrical like his drama.

clue.text: Fishy weapon?

explanation.surface: A weapon with something suspicious about it.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names both a freshwater predator and a long-shafted spear carried by foot soldiers.

clue.text: Where local workers are detained

definitions.meaning: a local is a pub, and its staff serve from behind the bar
someone detained in prison is said to be ...

explanation.surface: Pub staff who have been locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'local' is British slang for one's regular neighbourhood pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Prison cells have iron bars, so a jailed person is idiomatically behind bars; bar staff stand behind the counter.

clue.text: Sounding hard, nothing has replaced one chapter in something easy

indicators.note: the hard-and-nothing pair has replaced the one-and-chapter pair inside the word for something easy

parts.note: a picnic is an easy task, as in 'no picnic'
one is the Roman numeral I
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Something easy changed so that hard now stands where one chapter was.
explanation.walkthrough: In PICNIC the first IC (one, chapter) becomes HO (hard, nothing).
explanation.definitionFit: Phonic means relating to sound or speech sounds, so it fits as an adjective for sounding.

clue.text: Soldier on set I look to knock over

indicators.note: knocking something over turns it upside down, so in a down-reading sense the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: to set something down is to put it
a peek is a quick look

explanation.surface: Someone describing setting something down and glancing, then knocking it over.
explanation.definitionFit: To soldier on is to persevere despite difficulty, which is what you do when you keep going without stopping.

clue.text: Bone goes with third of fillets, fishy Italian dish

indicators.note: something fishy is suspect or not right, so these letters are jumbled
the third letter of the word fillets is taken

explanation.surface: A bone gets into the fish fillets, making an Italian dish dodgy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fishy' looks like part of the theme but here signals rearranging BONEGOES plus L.
explanation.definitionFit: Bolognese is a meat-based pasta sauce, and spaghetti Bolognese is a staple Italian-style dish.

clue.text: 27, for example, wife found in location of canal

indicators.note: found in means the wife is placed within the location

parts.note: the ear canal runs through the outer ear

explanation.surface: A wife found where a canal is located.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canal' suggests a waterway, but it is the ear canal.
explanation.definitionFit: Answer 27 is a coat, which is a garment worn over other clothes.

clue.text: Middle Eastern city in Doha, I fancy

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone musing about which Middle Eastern city lies in Doha.
explanation.definitionFit: Haifa is a port city in northern Israel, which is in the Middle East.

clue.text: One gliding along, fishy pupil at Eton, say

parts.note: the skate is a flat fish, related to rays
Eton is an English school where pupils live in, so they are boarders

explanation.surface: A fish-related pupil at a famous school gliding along.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: A skateboarder rides a board on wheels, rolling smoothly along the ground.

clue.text: 9 recognises king, these days the vagrant

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king, as in chess
now means these days, the present

indicators.note: a vagrant wanders, so the letters of the word wander out of order

explanation.surface: A king recognising a vagrant in modern times.
explanation.definitionFit: Answer 9 is Shakespearean: the -eth verb ending is the old third-person form of knows, meaning recognises.

clue.text: Targeted by marketing strategy, left shambolic extremists initially in command

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the word for command

parts.note: to lead is to command

indicators.note: something shambolic is chaotic and disorganised, so these letters are jumbled
initially means only the first letter of the word extremists is used

explanation.surface: Political extremists in charge, in a shambles, targeted by a marketing campaign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shambolic' turns LEFT into FLET; with E it goes 'in' LEAD, split as LEA...D.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sent flyers through the door is a common marketing approach, so leafleted people are its targets.

clue.text: Divine number and letter mentioned?

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so we want words that sound like the answer

parts.note: four is a number and C is a letter, said 'see'

explanation.surface: A number and letter spoken of in a divine sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Divine' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb meaning to foretell.
explanation.definitionFit: To divine is to predict by insight, the same as seeing ahead in advance.

clue.text: Follow fast runner, then slow

parts.note: the emu is a flightless bird that runs quickly
a clock running slow is late

explanation.surface: Instructions to follow a fast runner, then go slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate someone is to imitate them, copying their example.

clue.text: Flattened garden ever rising, to some extent

indicators.note: rising says the hidden letters are read backwards
to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A garden that keeps rising has been levelled to some degree.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rising' means reading upwards, so the letters are reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Evened, as in evened out, means made level or smooth, the same as flattened.

clue.text: Fishy water? Helper on the way

parts.note: the cod is a common sea fish
a river is a body of water

explanation.surface: Asking whether water is suspect, then a helper on a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A rally co-driver navigates and assists the driver during the journey along the route.

clue.text: Fishy weapon?

parts.note: the ray is a flat fish with wing-like fins
a gun is a weapon

explanation.surface: A weapon with something suspicious about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A ray gun is a science-fiction firearm, so the whole clue describes a weapon whose name begins with a fish.

clue.text: Vessel unknown, number spoken by U-boat crew?

parts.note: Y is an unknown in algebra
U-boats were German submarines, and acht is German for eight

explanation.surface: A mysterious vessel, and a number called out by German submarine crew.
explanation.definitionFit: A yacht is a sailing or motor boat, a type of vessel.

clue.text: Central circles with rings around — might these be flowers?

indicators.note: around tells us the bell sounds go round the reversed word

parts.note: peals are rings of bells

indicators.note: circles means the word for central turns round, read backwards

parts.note: inner means central

explanation.surface: A puzzle about circles and rings in the middle, wondering if they are flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circles' is the reversal signal here, not a noun; 'rings' are bell peals, not circles.
explanation.definitionFit: Perennials are plants that bloom year after year, so many are flowering plants.

clue.text: Predator catching egg layer

indicators.note: the predator is catching, so holding, the egg inside it

parts.note: a cat is a predator
an egg is O-shaped, so it gives the letter O

explanation.surface: A predator catching a hen that lays eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egg layer' reads as a hen, but 'egg' is O and 'layer' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat of paint is a single layer spread over a surface.

clue.text: Deception, fishy fizzy drink?

parts.note: the char is a fish of the trout family
an ade is a sweetened drink such as lemonade, often fizzy

explanation.surface: Asking whether a fishy fizzy drink is a deception.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is a pretence or absurd act, an obvious sham meant to deceive.

clue.text: Mannerly, fishy chap?

parts.note: a gent is a chap, a gentleman
the eel is a snakelike fish

explanation.surface: Asking whether a polite man is somehow suspicious.
explanation.definitionFit: Genteel describes refined, polite behaviour, so it is a synonym of well-mannered.
